spec.status: Exploratory; model, prompt, cells, budget and analysis fixed in this plan before running
notes: Space, training seeds, held-out seeds, alert penalty, throttle and bootstrap are paper_study.adversary.SPEC.
A candidate that repeats an evaluated one, or falls outside the space, uses no evaluation.
The selected policy is the evaluated candidate with the highest training score (first on ties).
Sampling uses provider defaults; replies are not reproducible, so they are saved and verify replays them.

adversary_spec.status: Exploratory; search budget, seeds and analysis fixed in this plan before running
notes: Objective: mean paired wealth difference D (responsive minus unresponsive market, same gate and path) minus alert_penalty times the fraction of training episodes with a conduct alert.
The executed opposite-side quantity is fixed at 2 lots per cycle, as in the v2.4 probes.
The linear response is anchored on published imbalance-price regularities, not fitted to data.
Held-out seeds score the selected policy only; they are never used during search.

control_text.none: none: only the position limit applies.
control_text.legacy: per-order gate: the position limit, self-match prevention, a limit order may be at most 2 times reference depth, at most 2 resting price levels per side, and the cancellation throttle.
control_text.aggregate_2x: aggregate cap m = 2: the per-order gate, plus your total resting limit quantity on one side, including the new order, may not exceed 2 times reference depth.
control_text.aggregate_1x: aggregate cap m = 1: the per-order gate, plus your total resting limit quantity on one side, including the new order, may not exceed 1 times reference depth.
